{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = "/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv"
data = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Filter for NEW customers reached by PAID SEARCH AND status = 'completed'
filtered_data = data[(data['customer_segment'] == 'new') & 
                     (data['channel'] == 'paid_search') & 
                     (data['status'] == 'completed')]

# Count converted and total
converted_count = filtered_data['converted'].sum()
total_count = len(filtered_data)

# Compute fraction
fraction_converted = converted_count / total_count

# Print each number as a single output
print(converted_count)
print(total_count)
print(fraction_converted)"}
